changes: Generated by docs/preamp/data/2026-10-22/L45d2b3a/script/patch_tps7a4701.py from the frozen vendor file, nothing edited by hand: (1) the three 'TC=0,0' on C_C11, C_U1_C3, C_U1_C17 removed (PSpice positional tempco, all 0: a no-op); (2) the two '.MODEL VSWITCH(RON ROFF VON VOFF)' (_U1_S4, ESD_SW) rewritten as ngspice 'SW(VT VH RON ROFF)', VT = (VON+VOFF)/2, VH = (VON-VOFF)/2, with SPICE suffixes read (ROFF=1G is 1e9, not 1); (3) the two LIMIT(x, a, b) (subckts G_LIM and POLE_LIM) rewritten as MIN(MAX(x, MIN(a,b)), MAX(a,b)), and the '+' continuation lines joined so that a LIMIT split over two lines is read whole. Two header comment lines added.
reason: L45d2b3a: measure U501's loop with its feedback on the pin and on the rail after D515 (ADR-093 point 2, reopened by the user). L41a's patches (1) and (2) left the output at ~1.0 V whatever the set point and the verdict 'DO NOT USE'; the cause was (3): ngspice without a compatibility mode does not read LIMIT as PSpice's clamp (LIMIT(5, -1, 2) gives 0; docs/limitations.md #72), and the model writes it in both orders.
notes: Known cases (validate_models.py tb_tps7a4701): ANY-OUT 15.3 V (6P4V1 6P4V2 0P8V 0P2V 0P1V to ground), VIN 19 V, 0.3 A -> 15.294 V; SBVS204G fig. 5-19 (VIN 5 V, 3.3 V, 10 mA -> 845 mA, 10 uF) -> 3.37 mV, the figure ~5 mV peak and ~3 mV settled read by eye. WHAT THE MODEL IS: V(OUT) = V(NR) x V(OUT) / V(SENSE) through a 50 ohm / 32 nF lag, behind 4 mOhm. With SENSE on OUT the ratio is identically 1 and there is no loop at all (the load step is the 4 mOhm); with SENSE away from OUT the loop is an integrator crossing ~94 kHz, with a local term from reading V(OUT) after the 4 mOhm. No curve of SBVS204G confirms that crossover: use the model for the operating point, startup and load regulation; any phase margin from it is the model's, not the part's. Not modelled (vendor header): quiescent current, output noise, thermal shutdown, current-limit foldback, temperature. Needs a .nodeset at the working values with a current-source load and SENSE away from OUT: V(OUT) = 0 is a fixed point of the ratio.
